'''Cyman Walz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Sometime during the war, he encountered a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] named [[Karrus Vayl]] and turned him to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]]. By [[3641 BBY]] he has retired on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], though Jedi Padawans still made pilgrimages to him. [[Ashara Zavros]] attempted such a pilgrimage, only for Walz to tell her that as an apprentice for a Sith Lord, she was no longer a Jedi.
